subject: Warning when using 'copy' function in spatio - temporal(spde)

messages.author: 512954c24bf42874
messages.subject: Warning when using 'copy' function in spatio - temporal(spde)
parts:
“Warning in inla.coreformula = formula, family = family, contrasts=contrasts,specification
f(j, ...): Number of unused groups >- the number of groups used: 4 >- 1, this is *usually* a misspecification”
Hi, experts.My prevalence data spans from 1975 to 2019, divided into four segments with knots set at 1975, 1986, 1997, 2008, and 2019. Meanwhile, my incidence data covers the period from 1991 to 2019, and for modeling purposes, I set knots at 1986, 1997, 2009, and 2019 to ensure stack indexing. My expectation was that the prevalence data for the period 1975-1985 would not copy the spatial effects from the incidence rate, but the subsequent three segments would. However, when using INLA, I encountered this warning.
knots_prevalance <- c(1975, 1986, 1997, 2008,  2019)
knots_incidence <- c(1986, 1997, 2008,  2019)
Even when I attempted to set the prevalence data into three segments to match the incidence rate data , I still received this warning.
knots_prevalance_3 <- c(1975,  1997, 2008,  2019)
knots_incidence_3   <- c(1975,  1997, 2008,  2019)
 Can you please explain what might be the issue.
my formula is
 y ~ -1 + Intercept + f(i, model = spde, group = i.group, control.group = list(model = "ar1")) +
    f(loc_id, model = "iid") + f(j, copy = "i", fixed = FALSE, hyper = list(theta = gaus.prior)) + f(loc_id_inc, model = "iid")  
i for prevalence, j for inciedence.

this is hard to say much about as the connection between knots_... and
i.group is not given.

you need to have i.group is to be integers in 1,2,..., ngroup


the warning shown is a warning, not error, it just say you have groups
that are not used. which is most often an error, but not always.
